source_caption_text:
Playboi Carti went live on Instagram and the viewer count kept jumping by about 10K on the beat 😂🔥

The clip starts around 39.5K. Then 47.8K. 58.8K. 66.7K. 73.7K. 81.6K. 89.5K. Same jumps people still talk about from that live.

This is the WLR-era IG live. Red dreads, tank, dancing in the room. The song tied to that run is “New Tank” off Whole Lotta Red , the record he previewed on live before the Christmas 2020 drop. That live peaked around 131K.

Whole Lotta Red debuted at No. 1 on the Billboard 200 with 100,000 first-week units and 126 million streams that week. “New Tank” is past 278 million Spotify streams now. The album itself is over 4 billion.
